description: The spec types the index and create request body as a bare `type: object` (the document), which the OpenAPI converter turns into no body member, so the operations could not send a document. Add a required `document` payload member sent as the whole JSON body. A document field never collides with the operations' own path and query members (`index`, `id`, `refresh`, `version`, ...). Source: the requestBodies.index and requestBodies.create entries of the official spec ("The document"), and https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/api-reference/document-apis/index-document/.
